title: CFPB 1071 Small Business Lending and AI Agents: A Subpart B Playbook for the Firewall, the Data, and the Filing
summary: Section 1071 added 81 data points and a firewall between demographic collection and credit decisions. How to put AI agents inside the small-business application without breaching Regulation B Subpart B.
